english: A headsman's edge ground onto the striking face. It finishes what you start.\n\n+10% to +35% damage (by quality) to anything below 30% health.
A car battery's worth of wiring wrapped around the grip, with the contacts filed sharp.\n\n5% to 15% chance (by quality) that a hit shocks the target and arcs to zombies within 3 m.
A sweat-stained wrap that somehow makes every kill feel like a deep breath.\n\nEvery kill gives back 5 to 20 stamina (by quality).
A counterweight that keeps the swing going. Stop swinging and you lose it.\n\nEach hit within 2 seconds of the last adds +5% melee damage, stacking 2 to 6 times (by quality).
A trigger job and a cheek rest tuned for one thing: the head.\n\n+10% to +35% headshot damage (by quality).
A flared magwell and a set of pre-loaded clips. Reloading is muscle memory now.\n\nReloads 8% to 30% faster (by quality).
An overcharged compensator that turns every shot into a shove.\n\n3% to 15% chance (by quality) that a hit knocks the zombie down. Shotguns roll for each pellet at 1/8 of the chance.

A launcher for tiny radio beacons that stick to whatever you shoot. Everyone with a receiver can see them.\n\nWhatever you hit is marked through walls for every player for 4 to 12 seconds (by quality).
A lucky rabbit's foot on a keychain. It wasn't lucky for the rabbit.\n\nZombies you kill are 10% to 40% more likely (by quality) to drop a loot bag.
A ported cylinder and a racing carburetor. It screams.\n\nChainsaws and augers run 8% to 25% faster (by quality).
A sifting screen clipped behind the head. Nothing worth keeping falls through.\n\n+5% to +25% ore, stone and wood (by quality) from what the tool breaks.
A magnet off a junkyard crane, cut down to fit a wrench. Screws and parts just jump to it.\n\n+5% to +25% salvage (by quality).
Razor wire woven through the lining. Grabbing whoever wears it is a mistake.\n\nZombies and animals that hit you take 5 to 20 damage (by quality).
A spring-loaded plate that slams out to meet a blow, then needs a while to reset.\n\nBlocks the next hit you take, with a clang. Recharges in 60 to 30 seconds (by quality).
A headset radio tuned to your party's channel. Callouts win fights.\n\nYou and party members within about 25 m deal +3% to +10% damage (by quality). Several radios don't stack.
Long-travel shocks and skid plates for roads that aren't roads anymore.\n\nYour vehicle takes 40% less damage from collisions and has 20% more pulling power.
A welded steel cowcatcher with spikes. It doesn't take up the plow's spot.\n\nZombies you run over take 75% more damage.
Keep hitting to keep your melee damage bonus.
The next hit you take is blocked.
